75f4f532c87ad992.description: About the Role Matar Al Baqmi Holding Company is seeking a Dispatcher - Supply Chain to join their team. This full-time role focuses on supporting logistics and delivery operations within the Supply Chain department. The Dispatcher will be responsible for coordinating daily deliveries and ensuring efficient truck utilization, timely deliveries, and clear communication among all stakeholders. Role Overview The primary objective of this position is to serve as a central coordination point, managing interactions between customers, drivers, dispatchers, and logistics personnel. Key responsibilities include monitoring vehicle movements, confirming customer readiness for deliveries, managing exceptions, and contributing to the continuous improvement of logistics performance. Key Responsibilities Monitor daily truck movements using GPS tracking systems, including departures, arrivals, unloading, and returns. Identify and address delayed, stationary, or route-deviating vehicles, following up with drivers on operational issues. Escalate significant delays, breakdowns, or route problems to relevant stakeholders. Track delivery trips against agreed turnaround times and maintain records of delays and recurring issues. Analyze delay trends and recommend corrective actions to improve fleet utilization. Contact customers prior to dispatch to confirm delivery readiness, verifying storage and silo capacity. Manage delivery schedules and postponement requests, communicating customer requirements and restrictions to logistics teams. Prevent unnecessary dispatches to customers unable to receive deliveries. Serve as the primary coordination point, keeping customers informed of schedules and significant delays. Communicate customer instructions and delivery requirements to drivers and assist in resolving delivery-related concerns. Support the execution of daily dispatch and delivery plans, coordinating truck availability with schedules. Follow up on delayed, postponed, and rescheduled deliveries, supporting optimization of truck allocation. Coordinate with Operations, Sales, Maintenance, and third-party logistics providers regarding delivery issues. Ensure accurate maintenance of delivery documentation and trip records. Proactively identify issues affecting delivery performance, such as vehicle breakdowns, unloading delays, storage limitations, and driver availability. Take immediate action to minimize disruption and escalate unresolved issues to the Logistics Supervisor or Manager. Maintain logs of exceptions, delays, and corrective actions. Prepare daily and weekly logistics reports covering planned versus completed deliveries, truck turnaround times, delayed deliveries, customer-related waiting and unloading delays, postponed or cancelled deliveries, truck utilization, and operational exceptions. Identify recurring issues and provide data-driven recommendations for improvement. Work Type This is a full-time position within Matar Al Baqmi Holding Company. Application Process Candidates interested in this Dispatcher - Supply Chain role are encouraged to apply.

75a96b24766ac0a5.company_name: Mohammad Al Habib Real Estate Co.
75a96b24766ac0a5.description: About Bechtel Corporation and the Jubail Project Bechtel Corporation has been instrumental in the development of Jubail, one of the largest civil engineering projects in modern times, located in the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia. Since the mid-1970s, Bechtel has managed this significant project, which continues to expand. Saudi Arabian Bechtel Company (SABCO) operates as the Management Services Contractor for the Royal Commission, overseeing engineering, procurement, and construction. The scope includes managing design submissions and supervising construction work by local contractors in Jubail and Ras Al-Khair Industrial Cities. The contract was renewed in June 2026 for another five years, focusing on new residential communities, infrastructure, and various public facilities. Role Summary: Area Safety Engineer The Area Safety Engineer reports to the Lead Safety Engineer or the Project ESH Manager. This full-time role is based in Al Jubail and involves conducting project-wide Environmental, Safety, and Health (ES&H) initiatives and providing essential technical support across various construction activities. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Conduct project-wide ES&H initiatives, including vehicle inspection campaigns, focused assessments of contract work sites (*, work at height, chemical storage, traffic management, environmental inspections, scaffolding, PPE, excavations). Provide technical support and review client contractor method statements and risk assessments. Offer safety technical support and assistance to contract projects during site visits. Participate in meetings with customers, project construction colleagues, and client contractors/subcontractors to advise on safety requirements. Provide recommendations and input for revising safety procedures, work processes, and other improvement measures. Conduct safety inspections/assessments of project construction activities to monitor compliance with applicable safety and health requirements, contractual commitments, permits, and the project’s ES&H Manual. Produce detailed reports on corrective actions. Develop and deliver training presentations as required. Undertake additional duties as assigned by the Lead Safety Engineer and Project ESH Manager. Qualifications and Experience College/University degree in a subject relevant to Management of ESH from an accredited institution. Minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience in the construction industry or related fields, demonstrating a thorough understanding of the role requirements. Demonstrated experience in implementing all aspects of Construction ESH Management. Experience in conducting safety inspections/assessments of project construction activities to monitor compliance with ES&H requirements. NEBOSH / International General Certification preferred, or a similar internationally recognized ESH certification. Experience working with construction contractors to ensure ESH standards are understood and complied with. Knowledge of hazardous materials, physical risk exposures, Personal Protective Equipment standards, and People Based Safety (behavioral safety) processes and procedures. Experience in managing and/or providing technical oversight of safety and/or health subcontractors or consultants. Knowledge of engineering and construction systems, methods, and work processes. Required Skills Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to explain ESH-related work processes and standards to contractors. Ability to prepare ESH training presentations and deliver training sessions effectively. Capability to work within a culturally diverse organization, recognizing and respecting differences. Self-motivated with good leadership skills and the ability to influence without direct authority. Demonstrated ability to influence key stakeholders in critical decision-making. Ability to work effectively within an integrated RC/Bechtel team across multiple levels, from working staff to Project Manager. Effective communication skills for delivering presentations to diverse groups, from senior managers to field workers, ensuring key messages are received. Knowledge of national and international environmental laws/regulations, industry standards for environmental compliance, and best management practices for minimizing environmental impacts during project execution. Knowledge of construction planning and execution. Experience in environmental monitoring and compliance inspection during construction. Knowledge of hazardous materials and waste management, erosion and sediment control methods, and restoration techniques. Work Environment This role is a full-time position based in Al Jubail, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia, supporting the ongoing development and expansion of the Jubail project.

75b91ef493776f85.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سما المنار للمقاولات والتجارة عن مهندس إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في القنفذة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تخطيط المشاريع وتنفيذها ومراقبتها لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة ضمن النطاق الزمني والميزانية المحددين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع وتنفيذ خطة متكاملة للمشروع، والتحكم في التغييرات، وتحديد نطاق المشروع بدقة من حيث البنود والأزمنة، مع التعرف على الجوانب الفنية المحددة لتنفيذ العمل. تقدير الأوقات والمواعيد النهائية للمشروع، وإعداد الجداول الزمنية باستخدام البرامج والتطبيقات المخصصة لتطوير جداول العمل، وتحديد المهام المجدولة وفترات تنفيذها والموارد المتاحة لكل منها. إدارة التكلفة والموارد المطلوبة لإنجاز المشروع، بما في ذلك تخطيط وإدارة الموارد البشرية والمادية والمعدات والتقنيين، وتقدير التكلفة المتوقعة بالتعاون مع مهندسي التكاليف والمهندسين المعنيين بالتنفيذ ومتابعة الإنفاق. إعداد وتطبيق خطة علاقات مع جميع الأطراف ذات الصلة بالمشروع، وتوفير أساس لتوزيع المعلومات ونشر حالة مراحل المشروع. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدارة المشاريع أو ما يعادله. القدرة على وضع خطط مشاريع متكاملة والتحكم في التغييرات. إتقان استخدام برامج وتطبيقات إعداد الجداول الزمنية للمشاريع. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم. القدرة على إدارة التكاليف والموارد بفعالية. مهارات تواصل قوية لإدارة العلاقات مع الأطراف المعنية. الدقة في إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الفنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في القنفذة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المهندس ضمن فريق متخصص في إدارة المشاريع لضمان تنفيذ المشاريع بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

75c64dca8d5dbd9c.description: About Lucid Motors Middle East Lucid Motors is dedicated to creating advanced mobility experiences through innovation, driving the world forward. The company's vehicles are built on proprietary technology and a software-defined architecture, reflecting a "Compromise Nothing™" approach in the global automotive market. This involves integrating performance with sustainability, and design with engineering. Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity models are designed to redefine their segments by combining range, performance, design, and spaciousness. This is achieved through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production managed in-house across global offices and manufacturing facilities. The Role: Quality Electrical Engineer (VRE) Powertrain Lucid Motors Middle East is seeking a Quality Electrical Engineer (VRE) Powertrain to join its team in King Abdullah Economic City, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for electrical and electronic Powertrain Quality engineering activities throughout the product lifecycle and manufacturing launch. The engineer ensures that electrical components, high-voltage interfaces, control systems, assembly processes, and end-of-line tests meet engineering specifications, Lucid Quality standards, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations. The role involves collaboration with Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Supplier Quality, Incoming Quality, Launch, Maintenance, Test Engineering, and Production teams to prevent defects and drive corrective actions. Key Responsibilities Manage Quality engineering activities for electrical and electronic Powertrain components and assembly processes, including electric motors, inverters, power electronics, wiring, connectors, sensors, control modules, and high-voltage interfaces. Ensure compliance of Quality deliverables at each launch milestone and confirm electrical product, software, test, and process readiness before production and volume ramp-up. Review electrical schematics, specifications, interface requirements, special characteristics, DFMEA/PFMEA, control plans, work instructions, and test standards for completeness and manufacturing applicability. Coordinate APQP/PPAP and validation of electrical parts and processes, including continuity, insulation resistance, dielectric withstand, grounding, connector engagement, pin integrity, torque, end-of-line functional tests, and diagnostic checks. Define incoming, in-process, control point, and end-of-line inspection and test requirements, and support test equipment qualification, measurement system analysis, calibration, golden samples, limits, and operator training. Monitor production Quality performance and lead containment, root cause analysis, corrective action, and effectiveness verification for electrical, electronic, diagnostic, and high-voltage defects. Lead cross-functional problem-solving for intermittent faults, connector and harness issues, sensor signals, communication faults, insulation failures, test escapes, and workmanship concerns affecting Powertrain Quality and Field Quality. Support equipment qualification, process validation, line trials, safe launch, layered process audits, and readiness reviews for new or changed electrical assembly and test processes. Partner with Supplier Quality to address electrical component nonconformities, verify corrective actions, and improve capability and parts maturity. Manage nonconforming product disposition with cross-functional teams and ensure traceability, segregation, repair validation, software or calibration control, and protection of internal and external customers. Analyze test, diagnostic, repair, audit, warranty, and field data to identify trends and implement preventive improvements. Support engineering and software change implementation by confirming validation, configuration control, documentation, training, parts readiness, and Quality approvals before production release. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. 2-5 years of experience in Powertrain, automotive manufacturing, testing, or product engineering within an automotive OEM or Tier 1 environment. Experience with electrical schematics, diagnostic tools, measurement systems, MSA, SPC, capability analysis, and automotive core tools. Ability to work on the manufacturing floor, support production priorities, and communicate technical issues effectively across different organizational levels. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering, or a related discipline. Practical experience with EV Powertrain electrical systems, electric motors, inverters, power electronics, high-voltage components, harnesses, sensors, controllers, or end-of-line testing. Experience supporting new product launches, greenfield manufacturing, or high-volume production ramp-up. High-voltage training or certification and familiarity with functional safety, configuration control, and vehicle network diagnostics. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in King Abdullah Economic City, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role requires collaboration with diverse teams across global offices and manufacturing facilities, contributing to the development and production of advanced electric vehicles.

Lead technology delivery for multi-asset sports ecosystems, including integrated sports districts, mixed-use developments, and city-scale environments. Ensure seamless integration with mobility, smart city platforms, digital identity, payments, and city operations. Structure long-term partnerships (OEMs, integrators, telcos, cloud, media, data, performance tech) to generate direct revenues, Capex savings, and Opex efficiencies. Qualifications and Experience 15+ years of senior technology leadership experience, including executive ownership of technology for major sports venues and sports organizations. Proven experience delivering large-scale, complex sports and entertainment assets from design through live operations (*, stadiums, arenas, mixed-use districts). 75e7bfb2c5cb765d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات عن أخصائي تمريض للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم رعاية تمريضية شاملة للمرضى، بدءًا من التقييم ووضع خطط الرعاية وصولاً إلى تنفيذ الإجراءات الطبية ومتابعة الحالة الصحية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقييم الوضع الصحي للمرضى، وجمع البيانات منهم ومن ذويهم، وتوثيقها وتحليلها لتحديد احتياجات الرعاية. إعداد خطط الرعاية التمريضية ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم نتائجها بشكل دوري. أخذ العلامات الحيوية للمرضى وعينات الدم والبول والبراز لإجراء الفحوصات المخبرية وفقًا لتعليمات الطبيب المعالج، ومتابعة إرسالها للمختبر والحصول على النتائج وإعلام الطبيب. إعطاء الأدوية والعقاقير الطبية والمحاليل الوريدية حسب تعليمات الطبيب المعالج. المشاركة الفعالة في عمليات الإنعاش القلبي والرئوي عند الحاجة. توثيق جميع الإجراءات والأنشطة التمريضية المقدمة للمرضى في السجل الطبي الخاص بهم. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال وعمليات التمريض. تطوير الممارسات المهنية يتولى أخصائي التمريض مسؤولية تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر، ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال التمريض والرعاية التمريضية لضمان تقديم أفضل مستويات الخدمة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التمريض. القدرة على تقييم الحالات الصحية بدقة ووضع خطط رعاية فعالة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع المرضى وذويهم والفريق الطبي. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في تقديم الرعاية التمريضية. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب التفرغ لتقديم الرعاية التمريضية المطلوبة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم الشروط للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات.

7542af44b6783c4c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الصافي دانون عن مدير مبيعات تجزئة للانضمام إلى فريقها في خميس مشيط، عسير. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق عمليات مبيعات التجزئة، والإشراف على مجموعة من متاجر البيع بالتجزئة، بالإضافة إلى إدارة الموازنة والموظفين والأداء العام للمتاجر. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة عمليات البيع بالتجزئة اليومية في المنشأة، وضمان التخصيص الأمثل للموارد. الإشراف على تخطيط شؤون الموظفين وتدريبهم لضمان الكفاءة التشغيلية. مراقبة أداء متاجر البيع بالتجزئة، وإدارة توزيع المكافآت والعلاوات المرتبطة بالأداء. اتخاذ القرارات اللازمة بشأن استبدال المديرين إذا اقتضت الضرورة، وفي التوقيت المناسب. وضع خطط التوسع بناءً على بيانات السوق، مع الأخذ في الاعتبار خيارات التوسع والانكماش المستقبلية. إدارة وحل شكاوى العملاء والنزاعات المحتملة بعد تصعيدها إلى مستوى المدير. ضمان الالتزام بجميع الأنظمة واللوائح والشروط المتعلقة بالعلامات التجارية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال مبيعات التجزئة أو إدارة المتاجر. فهم قوي لعمليات البيع بالتجزئة وإدارة الأداء. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية قوية وقدرة على إدارة وتوجيه الفرق. قدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق ووضع خطط استراتيجية. مهارات ممتازة في حل المشكلات وإدارة النزاعات. القدرة على ضمان الامتثال للوائح والمعايير. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة خميس مشيط بمنطقة عسير، وتتطلب الإشراف المباشر على عمليات المبيعات في متاجر التجزئة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

آمنة إلى الرئيس المباشر. تقديم المساعدة والتوجيه للموظفين والزوار بأسلوب مهني ولبق. الالتزام بالوقوف والترحيب بالموظفين والزوار بأسلوب مهني ولائق يعكس صورة الشركة. حسن الاستقبال والتعامل باحترام ولباقة مع جميع المراجعين والزوار. التعاون الكامل مع الإدارة وتنفيذ أي مهام إضافية تُكلّف بها الوظيفة. المرونة والاستعداد لأداء واجبات إضافية ضمن نطاق العمل الأمني عند الحاجة. الالتزام بالمظهر الرسمي Investment.

7583fda626a854f7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة عمر عبدالوهاب البدران عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التجميع والتركيب والتشغيل والصيانة الوقائية للمعدات والتجهيزات الصناعية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، ويوفر فرصة للمهندسين الجدد لبناء مسارهم المهني في بيئة عمل داعمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المهندس الميكانيكي مجموعة من المهام الأساسية التي تضمن سير العمليات الهندسية بكفاءة ودقة. تشمل هذه المهام: إعداد التصاميم والمخططات التفصيلية لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية بناءً على تعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذ هذه الإجراءات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوثيق نسب التقدم، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات الداخلية. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن تتوافر لدى المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة الميكانيكية أو مجال ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. معرفة قوية بمبادئ التصميم الميكانيكي وأنظمة التدفئة والتبريد والتكييف. المهارات المطلوبة القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرار. القدرة على التعلم السريع ومواكبة التطورات التقنية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق مؤسسة عمر عبدالوهاب البدران في مدينة مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتوفر بيئة عمل احترافية تدعم النمو والتطور المهني. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

756a50de9c58b198.description: Department: B2C Credit, Product Location: KSA Description Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 25 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money. The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 70,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores. Tabby generates over $18 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region. Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and is now valued at $6,5 billion. About the role Tabby is known for BNPL, but credit is our fastest-growing business. Saudi Arabia is our biggest market, and we want to build a full consumer lending line there. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager based in Saudi Arabia to build that business from the ground up and own its P&L. This is not a feature role. You will define what the product is, how it is priced, who qualifies, how it stays compliant. What you will be doing The product construct. Define the lending products we launch in KSA and across Tabby's other markets, including eligibility, tenors, limits, repayment structure, and what happens at every edge of the flow. The P&L. Revenue and cost are yours: profit rates and pricing etc. You build the business case, commit to the numbers, and explain every month why they moved. Work with legal, compliance and external partners, and so the customer experience does not suffer for it. Billing and servicing logic. Billing logic, repayment options, early settlement, late fees, collections hand-offs. This is detailed work: you will sit with engineering and specify, case by case, what lands where and why. Strategy. Where this business should be in 12 and 24 months, which segments we serve, what we build next, and what we deliberately do not build. 751b03575780cbbd.description: Lucidya is a leading AI-powered Customer Experience Management (CXM) platform in the MENA region, enabling enterprises to understand, engage, and serve their customers across digital channels at scale. As we continue to scale our platform and move toward IPO-scale engineering, we are looking for a Frontend Software Engineer who is passionate about building high-quality user experiences, learning quickly, and using modern engineering practices — including AI — to deliver better software faster. This role is ideal for an engineer with 0–2 years of professional experience who has a solid foundation in frontend development and wants to grow in an environment where ownership, speed, quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement matter. We don't measure impact by how many lines of code you write. We care about your ability to understand problems, build maintainable solutions, collaborate effectively, and continuously improve the way you work. Please note that this position is strictly open to Saudi nationals only. Applications from non-Saudi nationals will not be considered and will be disqualified from the recruitment process. What You Will Work On Modern Frontend Development Build and maintain production-grade web applications using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript . Develop reusable, maintainable, and scalable frontend components. Turn product requirements and designs into clean, intuitive, and responsive user experiences. Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs and real-time communication services . Work with WebSockets / Socket.IO to build real-time user experiences. Understand and work with event-driven flows connected to RabbitMQ and backend messaging systems. Handle real-time updates, reconnection scenarios, error states, and synchronization between live events and UI state. Manage server state efficiently using React Query / TanStack Query . Manage complex client-side state using Redux / Redux Toolkit when appropriate. Contribute to improving frontend architecture, performance, code organization, and maintainability. Quality & Testing Quality is part of development — not something that happens after development. Write reliable unit and integration tests using Jest . Build and maintain end-to-end tests using Playwright . Test your work thoroughly before considering it complete. Participate actively in code reviews and learn from feedback. Identify regressions, edge cases, and potential production issues before they reach users. Debug issues systematically and focus on root causes rather than temporary workarounds. Write code that is easy for other engineers to understand, review, test, and maintain. AI-Enabled Engineering We expect engineers to use AI as an engineering accelerator , not as a replacement for engineering judgment. Use AI coding tools effectively to research, prototype, implement, debug, test, and refactor solutions faster. Know how to provide AI tools with the right context, requirements, and constraints to generate useful results. Critically review and validate AI-generated code instead of accepting it blindly. Use AI to automate repetitive work and spend more time solving meaningful engineering problems. Continuously explore better AI-assisted workflows that improve productivity and engineering velocity. It's to deliver better outcomes in less time without sacrificing quality . Ask questions when necessary while developing the ability to investigate and unblock yourself. Give and receive constructive feedback during code reviews and technical discussions. Help teammates when needed and actively share what you learn. Take responsibility for the quality of what you ship. Treat the product as something you own — not simply a collection of assigned tickets. Stack Our frontend ecosystem includes: React JavaScript (ES6+) TypeScript React Query / TanStack Query Redux / Redux Toolkit Jest Playwright WebSockets / Socket.IO RabbitMQ REST APIs Git Modern AI-assisted development tools Experience with every technology is not required, but you should have strong fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly. What We Are Looking For Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely related field. 0–2 years of professional frontend development experience. Strong understanding of JavaScript fundamentals . Hands-on experience building applications with React . Good understanding of TypeScript and type-safe development. Good understanding of React fundamentals, including components, hooks, state management, rendering, and component lifecycle. Experience integrating frontend applications with APIs and handling asynchronous data. Familiarity with React Query / TanStack Query and Redux / Redux Toolkit . Understanding of frontend testing and experience with tools such as Jest and Playwright . Familiarity with real-time frontend architectures using WebSockets / Socket.IO . Basic understanding of message queues and event-driven systems , especially RabbitMQ . Understanding of common real-time challenges such as reconnection, duplicate events, stale data, race conditions, and keeping UI state synchronized. Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, responsive design, and browser fundamentals . Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows. Ability to debug problems rather than only work around them. Ability to write clean, readable, and maintainable code. Practical experience using AI tools to improve software engineering productivity . Strong willingness to learn and continuously improve. Good communication and teamwork skills. This Role Is a Strong Fit If You... Can take a feature from requirement to production instead of stopping when the code simply "works." Care about both speed and quality — you don't believe one has to come at the expense of the other. Use AI to multiply your productivity while still understanding and owning every solution you ship. Don't blindly copy AI-generated code — you question it, review it, test it, and improve it. Try to understand why something works, not only how to make it work. Investigate bugs and edge cases instead of immediately passing them to someone else. Treat testing as part of development rather than an optional final step. Care about code readability, scalability, and maintainability. Can receive code-review feedback and use it to improve. Communicate early when you are blocked. Enjoy collaborating and sharing knowledge with other engineers. Are curious about the product, not just the ticket assigned to you. Look for opportunities to improve existing code and engineering processes. Have a strong sense of ownership and don't need constant follow-up to get things done. Want to become a significantly stronger engineer over the next few years. What Success Looks Like Within your first months at Lucidya, we expect you to: Understand the frontend codebase, architecture, and development workflow. Deliver production features with increasing independence. Write clean and maintainable code that requires fewer review iterations over time. Build appropriate automated tests for the features you develop. Work confidently with REST APIs and increasingly understand our real-time architecture. Debug frontend and integration issues effectively. Use AI tools to noticeably improve your development speed and productivity while maintaining engineering quality . Participate meaningfully in technical discussions and code reviews. Collaborate effectively with your squad and other engineering
